title: Inventory service recovery: hld
summary: One internal inventory service, a PostgreSQL database and twelve authorised warehouse operators. Restore warehouse inventory updates within 30 minutes; data loss must remain below five minutes. One application instance and a standby database in the existing managed platform.

scenario.name: Inventory service recovery
scenario.scope: One internal inventory service, a PostgreSQL database and twelve authorised warehouse operators.
scenario.drivers: Restore warehouse inventory updates within 30 minutes; data loss must remain below five minutes.
scenario.design: One application instance and a standby database in the existing managed platform.
scenario.cost: EUR 18000 implementation and EUR 6000 annual operation; one-year benefit EUR 32000, with a 25 percent adoption uncertainty.
scenario.risk: Database replication delay can lose updates; lag alert at 60 seconds and hourly recovery-point checks reduce likelihood.
scenario.operations: Warehouse operations owns support from 06:00 to 22:00; the platform duty engineer handles recovery escalation.

solution_scope.boundary: One internal inventory service, a PostgreSQL database and twelve authorised warehouse operators.

solution_components.name: Inventory service recovery
solution_components.responsibility: Accept authorised transaction requests and return durable IDs

solution_components.name: PostgreSQL ledger
solution_components.responsibility: Persist unique event IDs and reconciled balances

solution_components.name: Morgan Lee
solution_components.responsibility: Own restore rehearsal and incident escalation

solution_interfaces.failure: Timeout after 5 seconds; retry twice with same event_id; then reject and alert
solution_interfaces.trust_boundary: Application service identity to restricted database role

delivery_strategy.deployment: Restore candidate configuration in isolated rehearsal; reconcile ledger before traffic switch
delivery_strategy.rollback: Disable candidate traffic; retain previous primary; restore previous configuration only after queue drain

identity.intended_usage: Development regression only; professional approval pending

evidence.description: Scenario assumptions and fabricated rehearsal observations for test development only; not real customer evidence.
